proposal.description: When deciding whether the record is empty, the episode detector ignores the OVERCURRENT bit, as if a recorded soft-start hiccup were routine and did not open an episode
proposal.reason: Suppose a window trip records only OVERCURRENT, and later, with no host read in between, another cause such as OTP or UVLO is captured after the retry. fault_time is then stamped again with the later time instead of keeping the time of the first overcurrent. It is also stamped again on every clock that a window trip alone stays live.
